# Current Proposed running creator-tail history

This **Proposed RUN-HIST author corpus** extends the independently admitted
empty-root HIST-C root tipR2/tick1 by two accepted running System edits across
ordinary boundary2. It contains complete connected Archive, Notebook and Transfer
fixtures for this selected family. It is not a production decoder, runtime queue,
general replay/collision qualification or human adoption of V3 rules.

From this directory:

```sh
python3 derive.py generate
python3 derive.py verify
```

Python standard libraries only. No prior helper is imported/executed, no Generator
runs during decode, and no Rust serializer or runtime output is the expected
oracle. Immutable admitted Catalog/Genesis/parent bytes are input dependencies;
parent Revisions/captures are independently replayed before extension. Generated
outputs are changed only by generate. An additional inline formula path checked
literal bytes/frames and exported case strengths independently of this helper;
that remains author checking, not the required independent reviewer verdict.

## Exact journey and private/portable separation

The admitted empty Genesis has all30 State fields and no initial Receipt. Parent
paused S1 creates Alpha, paused S2 edits Beta and ordinary1 changes tick only,
retaining rootR2. This root has no World/Star/actor/assets/industry/ecology/combat
work. All original parent Revisions, root fork inputs, three receipt Anchors and
Notebook Bookmark1 are preserved exactly.

At published rootR2/tick1, document accepted mark2/branch mark0 and queue empty,
prepare two running edits. Both envelopes bind the *same published* rootR2/tick1
State digest, while expected_pending_sequence is0 then3. Neither envelope claims
that the queued R3 prefix is already committed. AcceptedCommand application_tick
is2; ordinals are document-global S3 thenS4. Acceptance stages private immutable
Revision/capture and advances the durable mark; it publishes no tick2 Receipt.

Private working State first sets tick2 before phase1. First capture binds this
Beta State with historical next_sequence2 and logical parentR2. The first edit
makes Delta and then sets next_sequence3. Second capture binds that exact Delta
prefix at tick2/logical parentR3; the second edit makes Epsilon and then sets
next_sequence4. Both state_digest and permitted_snapshot_digest hash each exact
wrapped STATE prefix. branch_sequence stays0. Header updates are orchestration,
not creator Changes. Each operation has one exact systems Change, empty resources,
passenger_delta0, no cascade and no new entity allocation.

Execution reconstructs and compares both accepted prefixes and operations. Two
creator_intervention events append in accepted order, phase1/ordinals0,1, with
creator provenanceR3/R4. All later families are empty. One final boundary2 Receipt
seals the complete ID-free payload, with applied_revisions strictly full-ID sorted
and events in emission order. Event IDs derive only after Receipt sealing.
Publish both Revisions/final headR4/tip2/State/Receipt atomically and clear tail0.
No first-command-only Receipt, portable queue/cache, new command or VIEW domain is
introduced. Intermediate working snapshots are source captures, not completed
HistoryViews authenticated by the final State.
[schema71–75,1751–1759,2329–2339,2371–2419,2422–2454,2456–2485]

Archive stores applied inputs and genuine Anchors, not private AcceptedCommands or
receipt bytes. It selects rootR4/tick2 by default while preserving every earlier
publication. The fourth whole-Receipt Anchor binds that final publication. Notebook
reattaches to the exact new Archive integrity, appends Bookmark2 and next_ordinal3.
Transfer includes the exact admitted Catalog/Archive/Notebook and a reachable
selected view, independently of active_view. Full ID/key sorts are applied to
newly constructed output; submitted unsorted input is never repaired.

## Explicit limitations

No child ordinary extension or abandoned acceptance/high-water-hole lifecycle is
implemented in this slice. Bookmark holes are existing Notebook metadata semantics,
not proof of a running queue abandonment. No running partial publication, accepted
abandonment/Undo/rebase, faulted queue, combined fork/edit, generation race or store
lifecycle is qualified. Intermediate-running selected-view semantics remain open;
only genuine committed publications are selected here.

The helper recursively materializes and buffers JSON. It is not the source's safe
streaming parser or bounded execution engine. No UTF8 offset/syntax-depth/earliest
member-duplicate priority, general stage7–10 multifault ordering, bounded memory/
visits/polls/cancel/publication fence, maximum capacity or durability qualification
is claimed. Its unexported internal errors are not authoritative decoder goldens.
Some local equal-ID/key handling is narrow; the general retained-history issuance
scanner, transient removed allocations and Branch collision namespace remain
unqualified. The one original System creator frame and inherited origin are
reproduced; that is not a general collision result.

No inhabited phase2/phase5/Actor32/forecast/diplomacy/combat or six-gap closure is
claimed. Source8, historical artifacts and all other corpora remain exact. All
mechanics remain Proposed and human/runtime approval absent. This new author
checkpoint requires independent full review before scoped corpus acceptance.
